mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 68 degrees near the Public Library with clear skies and a moderate air quality index of 51.
City officials remind residents that the Plan Commission reviews new projects this Monday, October 5th. Also, mark your calendars for trick-or-treat night on October 31st from 5 PM to 8 PM.
Today features Hop Haus Trivia at the brewery, while tomorrow brings the downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory.
In recent police activity, officers identified a suspect on September 21st regarding a retail theft involving candy at a store on East Verona Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently open for business and will remain open until 10 PM this evening.
